cost: B input bytes,C concepts,L links,R auxiliary rows: O(B+C log C+LC+R log R), plus linear duplicate scans of selections/measures/relations; retained tables/generated text. Recursive directory walk has no symlink-cycle/resource cap.
description: Independent build-time seed compiler: sorted markdown traversal, fenced blocks, declaration/link validation and Rust tables plus optional TSV compilation.
forward: F(root,exclude,out) walks sorted *.md paths, excludes path substrings, extracts closed blocks, inserts declarations and verb-class concepts, validates canonical code uniqueness, link endpoints/pairs, *_cats and principle ids, then emits lexical concept indices. First encountered verb lemma wins. absurdity/idioms append tables; expressions writes before global.rs.
inverse: Generated tables admit seeds differing in whitespace/comments, ignored/excluded blocks, absent/unreadable optional files. Lexical indices do not reconstruct seed traversal; some provenance survives file fields. No preimage in kg Registry Id space is established.
limitations: Nonempty optional-table paths and tale ordering remain source-derived; no generated-Rust compilation, symlink/resource faults.
